item.title: Anthropic Announces Successful IPO and Concurrent Private Placement
item.description: Anthropic completed its IPO, selling 1.127 billion shares at $83 each, raising $93.5 billion. Additionally, it sold 313 million shares to tech giants in a private placement, bringing total proceeds to $119.5 billion. Anthropic aimed to raise capital to fund its growth and operations, addressing the need for financial resources in the rapidly expanding AI sector. — Upstream (Anthropic News): https://www.anthropic.com/news/ipo-close

item.title: Ravi Vakil claims proof of Riemann Hypothesis by Alessandro Masullo may exist
item.description: Ravi Vakil, a professor at Stanford, claims there is a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis by Alessandro Masullo that is currently being polished for human readability. The Riemann Hypothesis, a long-standing problem in mathematics, if proven, could have significant implications for number theory and related fields. — Upstream (r/singularity): https://www.reddit.com/r/singularity/comments/1y1bugz/ravi_vakil_of_stanford_claims_there_is_already_a/

item.title: Explore Qwen4-Max on Nous Portal for 5 Days
item.description: Qwen4-Max, a new AI model from Alibaba, is available for free on the Nous Portal for 5 days in partnership with @inferact. It addresses the need for businesses to test advanced AI models without significant upfront investment. — Upstream (X · @Alibaba_Qwen): https://x.com/Alibaba_Qwen/status/2123328957022081036

item.title: Google's Gemini 4 Neon for complex coding and analysis at lower cost
item.description: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a new model that offers advanced intelligence for complex coding and analysis at a lower cost. The new model aims to address the need for more powerful and cost-effective tools for complex coding and analysis in the banking sector. — Upstream (Google DeepMind): https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-gemini-4-neon/

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.329
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.329 added warnings for missing hooks, improved task management, and enhanced error reporting for remote servers. It also supports Code Mode with OpenTelemetry while maintaining tracing. The update addresses issues related to missing hooks, task management, and remote server errors, enhancing the reliability and user experience of the software. — Upstream (claude-code Release): https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329

item.title: RL post-training in diffusion transformers significantly enhances visual quality and…
item.description: Researchers found that RL post-training improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers by using a fixed set of steering vectors. The study addresses the challenge of enhancing complex visual tasks in AI models without requiring extensive retraining or input-dependent transformations. — Upstream (arXiv): https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26627v1

item.title: Frostbite: AI-Designed CPU Beats a dual-issue, in-order CPU core by 4.59x in performance per watt
item.description: Architect Labs' AI systems discovered, designed, and verified a new CPU architecture called Frostbite, achieving 4.59x performance per watt compared to a modern dual-issue, in-order CPU core. The project aims to address the stagnation in CPU core improvements and explore novel hardware designs that could significantly outperform human-made architectures. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://architectlabs.com/blog/frostbite

item.title: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra Models Now Available for Use
item.description: The GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra models have been released, offering faster and more efficient processing capabilities. These models aim to address the need for quicker and more efficient AI processing in various applications. — Upstream (X · @sama): https://x.com/sama/status/2122798039899263456

item.title: vLLM v0.34.0
item.description: vLLM v0.34.0 introduces several new models and improvements to its cache and runner systems, enhancing performance and reducing memory usage. The update addresses the need for improved model performance and resource efficiency in banking applications, particularly in handling large datasets and complex queries. — Upstream (vLLM Release): https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.34.0

item.title: langchain-openrouter==0.3.0
item.description: langchain-openrouter 0.3.0 has dropped support for Python 3.10, now requiring at least Python 3.11, and has updated the minimum version of langchain-core to 1.8.3. The update addresses the end-of-life status of Python 3.10, ensuring compatibility and security for the software. — Upstream (LangChain Release): https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/langchain-openrouter%3D%3D0.3.0

item.title: Google workers push back against AI policy in schools
item.description: Hundreds of Google workers are protesting a new policy that would block schools from using Google's Gemini AI tools if they choose not to. The issue is about balancing innovation with parental and community concerns over AI's role in education. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2026/11/google-alphabet-union-school-ai-protest-gemini-workers-petition/

item.title: Riemann Hypothesis May Have Been Solved with AI Assistance
item.description: A researcher claims that Claude, an AI, may have assisted in potentially solving the Riemann Hypothesis, a long-standing mathematical problem. The researcher expresses amazement at the progress made during the process. Reportedly (unverified): the Riemann Hypothesis, a conjecture about the distribution of prime numbers, has been a central problem in mathematics for over a century. — Upstream (Bluesky · @emollick): https://bsky.app/profile/emollick.bsky.social/post/3n2qvqp4fts2e

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: Reasoning model for laptops and real-time tasks
item.description: Inkling 2 Mini, a looped transformer model, is released. It runs middle layers three times per words to enhance reasoning and reduce words usage. It has compact scale and can run on consumer laptops. The model addresses the need for powerful reasoning capabilities on limited hardware, such as laptops, for tasks requiring detailed processing. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/

item.title: Epic Games Explores AI for Unreal Engine
item.description: Epic Games is exploring the use of AI to enhance the Unreal Engine, potentially improving game performance and player experience. The goal is to address issues like variable performance across different devices and networks, ensuring a smooth gaming experience. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://spectrum.ieee.org/epic-games-unreal-engine-ai

item.title: End of Easy Distillation from OpenAI and Anthropic Models May Slow Open-trained model files…
item.description: The ease of distilling knowledge from OpenAI and Anthropic models may have contributed to the relative slowdown in the progress of open-trained model files models. We are uncertain about the extent to which distillation has been key to rapid improvement. The post suggests that the difficulty in distilling knowledge from these models may be hindering the development of open-trained model files models, which are crucial for various applications in the banking sector. — Upstream (Bluesky · @emollick): https://bsky.app/profile/emollick.bsky.social/post/3n2req7quy225

item.title: Romanian lawyer barred from representing applicants for 2 years due to unverified AI-generated…
item.description: A Romanian lawyer was barred from representing clients for two years after submitting legal documents containing numerous errors, including unverified AI-generated citations. The case highlights the potential risks of relying on unverified AI-generated content in legal contexts, emphasizing the need for rigorous verification. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.echr.coe.int/w/romanian-lawyer-barred-for-two-years-from-representing-applicants-before-the-court-over-unverified-ai-generated-citations

item.title: 35 human labs deploy digital helpers for collaborative scientific research
item.description: 35 human labs deployed digital helpers that worked together to publish 936 scientific papers, publicly retracted mistakes, and founded a peer review journal. The project aimed to enhance the efficiency and transparency of scientific research through AI collaboration. — Upstream (Bluesky · @emollick): https://bsky.app/profile/emollick.bsky.social/post/3n2pqcy4cbs2g

item.title: Apple Developing digital helpers for Web Browsing and App Automation
item.description: Apple is hiring an engineer to develop a digital helpers that can browse the web, work across apps, write code, and call services. Apple aims to enhance user experience by automating tasks and improving interaction between apps and services. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038227/apple-ai-agent-engineer-job-listing

item.title: Court Rules AI-Generated Probable Cause Invalid Under 4th Amendment
item.description: A court ruled that AI-generated probable cause cannot be used in legal proceedings, citing the 4th Amendment's protection against unreasonable searches and seizures. The ruling addresses concerns about the reliability and bias of AI in legal contexts, ensuring that evidence must be human-generated. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://www.techdirt.com/2026/11/19/court-tells-cops-that-the-4th-amendment-doesnt-cover-ai-generated-probable-cause/

item.title: Distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them
item.description: Research shows that distillation can reproduce powerful AI capabilities without the safeguards built around them. The research addresses the risk of AI models' capabilities being extracted and used without the same safety measures. — Upstream (X · @OpenAI): https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123862344422088794

item.title: MedChemBench: New benchmark for AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry
item.description: MedChemBench is a new benchmark for AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry, allowing researchers to test and compare the performance of AI models in drug discovery. It addresses the challenge of validating AI models in the complex and data-intensive field of medicinal chemistry. — Upstream (X · @OpenAI): https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2123856316187975756

item.title: Levent Alpöge Claims Proof of Riemann Hypothesis and Beyond
item.description: Levent Alpöge claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis, a long-standing mathematical conjecture, and its Generalized and Extended versions. The Riemann Hypothesis, if proven, would provide deep insights into the distribution of prime numbers, impacting various fields including number theory and cryptography. — Upstream (Simon Willison): https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/20/levent-alpoge/

item.title: Combatting Adversarial Distillation to Safeguard Model Outputs
item.description: OpenAI developed a layered approach to protect against adversarial distillation, where models can be used to extract and misuse capabilities without proper safeguards. The problem addressed is the risk of bad actors reproducing advanced AI model capabilities without the necessary safety measures. — Upstream (OpenAI News): https://openai.com/index/combatting-adversarial-distillation
